title: Look et al.: A Design Library of Academic Web Pages for Humans and AI Agents
description: 130 paper project pages and researcher homepages selected for visual design, each with a DESIGN.md written from the rendered page (colors, typography, spacing, layout metrics, components, page modules and agent prompts), plus the tools and the reconstruction test used to check them. Site: https://dengzhe-hou.github.io/looketal/
